notes: All 25 candidates read; none lists named doctoral graduates or placements. Twenty are TU Dortmund pages (graduate-center events, bachelor/master thesis pages, and single-dissertation news items in education, sociology, spatial planning and biochemistry). Two TU Dortmund business-faculty event pages (URLs ending -55898 and -55899, same content) announce the public display of Svenja Marie Huelter's dissertation on data-driven HR decision-making (display 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-19); they are events and do not state the degree was awarded, so they are classed not-a-list, but the same event calendar names other WiWi dissertation displays/disputations (Daniel Kunz, Christian Ertel, Samuel Karras) and may help an integrator find the faculty's doctoral list. The Texas Tech political science page links to a separate 'Placements' page, which is out of scope (political science). Institutions by host kept unchanged.
